product_metadata.title: Amazon Basics Room Darkening Blackout Curtain Rod - 88" to 120", Dark Bronze (Espresso)
features: Curtain rod for window treatment in a bedroom, living room, or other living space
Made of durable metal with a Dark Bronze (Espresso) finish
Adjustable length from 88 - 120 inches end-to-end, excluding finials; 91.25 - 123.25 inches including wraparound ends; wall mount hardware and instructions included for easy install
Curved at both ends, wrapping curtains around the window from end to end, blocking out light while insulating the room
5/8-inch rod diameter capable of handling moderately heavy fabrics; can hold up to 20 pounds
description: AmazonBasics room-darkening curtain rod - 88" to 120", Espresso (Dark Bronze)
